summary: A downward probing wand reaches a floor potion through zap_updown -> bhitpile -> zap.c:bhito. C returns whether its appearance was previously known, then observes the object and learns the wand when newly revealed; js/zap.js refuses the WAN_PROBING callback before those state changes.

source.branch: bhito: floor potion is neither wand nor bypassed; WAN_PROBING sets res=!obj->dknown, observes obj, checks container/tin/egg special cases, and learns the wand if res is true.
callers: zap.c:zap_updown -> zap.c:bhitpile -> zap.c:bhito for downward wand zaps
dependencies: zap.c:learnwand and zap.c:bhitpile are present in js/zap.js

evidence: C zap.c:2228-2277 implements WAN_PROBING in bhito: save !dknown as res, call observe_object, handle container, statue, tin and egg knowledge, then set learn_it when res. The common tail calls learnwand if observable and returns res.
JS js/zap.js:2999-3089 refuses WAN_PROBING through UnsupportedZapError before observe_object or learnwand. The whole bhito callback must preserve the C guards and return value consumed by bhitpile.

C zap.c:3392-3399 routes downward zaps through bhitpile and bhito; JS js/zap.js:3392 does likewise. The v12 independently recorded C case stops at zero-based step 42 with 42 of 44 screens matched and 2 remaining (challenges/evaluations/20260929033350-v12.json).
